upgrade.restartCommandHint: 升级替换代码后执行的重启命令（会被服务端真实执行，如 docker compose restart backend）；留空表示不自动重启，升级完成后提示人工重启。
upgrade.settingsConfigured: 已配置（升级后自动执行）
upgrade.settingsNotConfigured: 未配置（升级后将提示人工重启）
upgrade.saveSettingsConfirm: 该重启命令会被服务端真实执行，确认保存吗？
upgrade.pathsHint: 升级只替换白名单内的代码路径；下面的数据 / 凭据路径永远不会被触碰。
upgrade.packagesHint: releases/ 目录下的更新包（含体积、构建时间、是否带 .sha256）。下载走带鉴权的文件响应。
upgrade.planHint: 预演升级包会替换与被跳过的文件（只读，不改任何文件）；需本地存在 releases/update_{version}.zip。
upgrade.planSummary: 将替换 {replace} 个文件，跳过 {skipped} 个文件
upgrade.planCollisions: 与保护路径冲突（需人工确认）
upgrade.executeHint: 真实执行会替换白名单内代码文件、执行数据库迁移、清理缓存，并可能重启服务；失败自动回滚。必须二次确认。
upgrade.stopService: 升级前停止的进程（可选）
upgrade.stopServiceHint: ops/进程监督 里登记的进程名；填了就按「停服 → 替换 → 起服」编排，留空则不停服。
upgrade.executeConfirm: 将真实替换代码文件，并对「{version}」执行数据库迁移、清理缓存，服务可能短暂中断。确定继续吗？
upgrade.executeStarted: 升级已开始，请稍后刷新查看状态
upgrade.backupsHint: 升级会先把被覆盖的原文件备份到 backups/update_backups/；回滚按 manifest.json 精确还原（本次新增的文件会被删除）。
upgrade.rollbackConfirm: 将按备份「{id}」还原被替换的代码文件（本次新增的文件会被删除）。确定回滚吗？

upgrade.restartCommandHint: Command run after code is replaced (executed for real on the server, e.g. docker compose restart backend). Leave empty to skip auto-restart and be prompted for a manual restart.
upgrade.saveSettingsConfirm: This restart command is executed for real on the server. Save it?
upgrade.pathsHint: An upgrade only replaces code paths on the allow-list; the data / credential paths below are never touched.
upgrade.packagesHint: Packages under releases/ (with size, build time, and whether a .sha256 is present). Downloads go through an authenticated file response.
upgrade.planHint: Preview which files an update package will replace or skip (read-only). Requires releases/update_{version}.zip to exist locally.
upgrade.planCollisions: Collisions with protected paths (manual review required)
upgrade.executeHint: A real upgrade replaces allow-listed code files, runs database migrations, clears the cache, and may restart the service; failures roll back automatically. Double confirmation required.
upgrade.stopServicePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep it running
upgrade.stopServiceHint: A process name registered in ops/supervisor; if set, it orchestrates stop → replace → start; leave empty to skip.
upgrade.executeConfirm: This will actually replace code files and run database migrations and clear the cache for "{version}"; the service may be briefly interrupted. Continue?
upgrade.executeStarted: Upgrade started. Refresh later to check progress
upgrade.backupsHint: An upgrade first backs up the files it will overwrite to backups/update_backups/; rollback restores exactly per manifest.json (files added by this upgrade are removed).
upgrade.rollbackConfirm: Restore the replaced code files from backup "{id}" (files added by this upgrade will be deleted). Roll back?
